images.author: TenPoundHammer
images.caption: Lucky's Market of Traverse City, Michigan

brief: A 2010s single-storey grocery: a big gabled front of red and cream panels with a neon script sign, a deep canopy over the entrance and a glazed front, a car park. One photo. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: a 2015 grocery (Traverse City): a corrugated-metal-and-board 'farm barn' box with a green steel canopy, neon-style script channel letters, glass entries; mulched landscape islands in the parking lot

why.note: the 2010s 'farmhouse' grocery: rustic cladding on a standard box
